warnings: This is the ring/eave tie-beam plan at wall-top level (per S-13/หน้า40, CN2 rises 'from floor2 up to +6.65m' — that is this level). West grid1-2 bay east (grid2-3, rows D-C and C-B) segments were zoomed and read directly; several east-side and lower (row B/row A) segments could not be individually zoomed in this pass and are recorded by inference from the same topology already confirmed on the west side and on the floor-beam plans (S-04/S-05) — those are marked span_source 'unresolved' with a lower confidence_score rather than asserted as directly read.

'RB1/RB1' is printed (doubled) at two wall segments (grid1 vertical D-C, and grid1 vertical B-A near 'SX') — recorded as a single RB1 element per segment with a note preserving the doubled printed text; genuine meaning (two stacked members vs. a drafting duplicate) not resolved.

Four 'CX' pedestals (short roof-support columns, 0.15x0.15, per S-13/หน้า40) sit inside the 'โล่ง' (open/void, i.e. no ceiling below the roof) bays at local offsets dimensioned from the RB1/RB2 lines themselves (e.g. '1.75', '0.75', '0.25') rather than from the main grid — their exact grid_ref could not be resolved to a grid point and is recorded as an approximate bay reference with the printed local offsets kept in each element's note.

'RB2' appears twice as a real beam and both are now recorded: the row-D grid1-grid2 segment, and a full-height interior member on dummy line 1" running row C to row B (4.00m). An earlier pass read the second one as 'a short label next to a CX pedestal, not clearly a full grid-to-grid segment' and left it out — it is a continuous beam, and two of the four CX pedestals sit on it.

WEST 'S1' BOX (grid1' to grid1, rows D to C) was missing entirely: three RB1 segments frame it — D1'-D1 (1.10), C1'-C1 (1.10) and the west edge D1'-C1' (2.20). An earlier pass stopped the ring beam at grid1 and recorded only the grid1 vertical (the doubled 'RB1/RB1' mark). Flagged by Makham 2026-08-26.

The CX pedestals are dimensioned from the beams they sit on, not from the main grid, and the sheet's own numbers are CENTRE-TO-CENTRE here: '1.75' locates the 1" line from grid2, '0.75' locates row C' below row C, and '0.25' places the third CX just west of grid2. That is the opposite of the printed-face convention this house uses for its edge dimensions (1.10, 0.50, 0.90) — see the grid master's warnings.

'SX' (a void/soffit marker distinct from 'โล่ง') appears above the S1 room (grid1-2 x B-A) on the east side — recorded as element_type 'slab' per the SO/SI/SX/ST convention (§10), spec not detailed on this sheet.
